subject: Data Engineering
title: Data Lineage
description: A quick, practical guide to Data Lineage.

hook.text: The revenue number on the dashboard is wrong. But which of 30 upstream transformations introduced the bug?

buildup.text: Data lineage tracks how data flows from source to destination through every transformation step.

discovery.text: With lineage, you can trace any output back to its source tables, transforms, and original inputs.

twist.text: Lineage also goes forward: when a source changes, you can see every downstream table it will affect.

climax.text: Lineage turns debugging from guesswork into a traceable path. It's the data equivalent of a stack trace.

punchline.text: Know where data came from. Know where it goes.

quiz.question: What does data lineage track?
options: How data flows from source through transformations to destinations
How many users access the data
